record.summary: The two knowledge commands. explain joins a path against FINDINGS.md research sections (backticked path-pattern headings with <placeholder> segments) plus the path's observed event history. peek is the single content-viewing path in the tool: read-only, size-capped, contained to the observed universe, and unconditionally redacted (secret-shaped JSON fields, env assignments, known token formats, long hex and base64 runs). There is no unredacted read path and no bypass flag, by design.
record.title: explain (FINDINGS join) and peek (redacted content viewing)
